in_sanskrit.name: इशान्त
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: The name Ishant is derived from the Sanskrit word ईशान् (Ishana), which means the 'Lord' or 'God'. In Hinduism, Ishana is one of the five principal deities and is often depicted as the god of all creation and destruction.

in_hindi.name: इशांत
in_hindi.long_meaning: The name Ishant is derived from the combination of the names Ishan (ईशान, meaning 'Lord' or 'God') and the suffix 't' (त), which is a common suffix in Indian names to denote 'belonging to' or 'serving'. Therefore, Ishant can be interpreted as 'belonging to Ishan' or 'serving Ishan'.

in_tamil.name: இஷாந்த
in_tamil.long_meaning: The Tamil name Ishant is derived from the combination of the name Ishan (இஷன், meaning 'Lord' or 'God') and the suffix 't' (த), which is a common suffix in Indian names to denote 'belonging to' or 'serving'. Therefore, Ishant can be interpreted as 'belonging to Ishan' or 'serving Ishan' in Tamil.

in_telugu.name: ఇశాంట

in_marathi.name: Ishant
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे God of Protection
in_marathi.long_meaning: Ishant हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Ishant is a compound name derived from two words: 'Ish' and 'An'. Ish means God, while An means protection. Thus, Ishant means 'God of Protection'.
